snippet.text: `"${at}.fallbacks" names a thinking level for ${levelled.model}, so the route must name its own; set "${key}"`,

message.text: checkRouteLevels interpolates the fallback model name from melian.yaml into the ConfigError message unescaped; the name schema only requires minLength 1.

explanation.what: checkRouteLevels interpolates the fallback model name from melian.yaml into the ConfigError message unescaped; the name schema only requires minLength 1.
explanation.whatToDo: Escape control and bidi characters (e.g. JSON.stringify or a sanitizer) in the name, or restrict the name schema.
explanation.whyHere: A head author controls the name, and the message is printed to terminals/logs, so ESC and bidi characters reach them.

properties.failureScenario: melian.yaml with models.heavy fallbacks [{model: "faux/a\u001b[31mX\u202E", thinking: medium}] and no models.heavy.thinking. loadConfig throws ConfigError whose message contains a raw ESC and U+202E (probe p242 ran the head's loadConfig and observed this).
